## The previous part ends

- t: ወትቤሎ ፡ መሐል ፡ ሊተ ፡ በአምላክከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢትትኀየለኒ ፤ እመቦ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ተስሕትኩ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ነኣስ ፡ እወርድ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጻማ ፡ ወሕማም ፡ ወምንዳቤ ፡ በፍኖት ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
- i: She said to him: "Swear to me by your God, the God of Israel, that you will not overpower me. If I should stray from some small human law (?), I will go down into toil and sickness and distress on the way."

Words in this part: 468.
